SELF_AUDIT.SCALABILITY_CURVE: Below weight 0.3 the solver uses central sphere SDF authority, slower hydraulic response, larger anti-stuck SDF skin, no midpoint CCD, and skips the six secondary probes. The low-probe telemetry flag is calculated with 1.0 - math.step(0.5, GlobalQualityWeight), while the actual authority math stays on Smooth01 curves. From 0.35 to 0.85 the secondary probe shell radius expands through Smooth01 rather than a binary mode; active shell contacts accumulate into a bounded MTV, non-finite probe penetration is rejected, finite penetration is capped, penetrating probe normals are finite-normalized, and the second secondary residual pass only runs after real contact. Clamp surface eligibility uses a continuous wallness curve from abs(SDF normal.y), contracting acquire/release distance toward -contactRadius on flat floor/ceiling normals instead of letting them become magnetic anchors. SDF vertical bounds are finite-sanitized before distance math, desired yaw is wrapped before trigonometry, and fault recovery resets AnchorNormal through a finite fallback. Contact response continuously changes from stronger low-tier tangential scrape damping to lighter high-tier sliding. SDF floor/wall/ceiling normals now blend inside WallSoftnessMeters while retaining the conservative minimum distance, so corner contacts stop flipping between unrelated normals without extra SDF taps. From 0.72 to 1.0 the solver adds a weighted midpoint CCD pre-sample and tightens SDF skin from 0.04m toward 0.015m to reduce high-speed cave tunneling without making low-tier hardware pay for extra SDF taps.

Disable unregisters fixed/post-fixed lanes and waits for non-blocking late-frame completion instead of forcing Complete.

SELF_AUDIT.COMPILE_GUARD: Exosuit implementation does not contain direct using references to Hecton8.World or Hecton8.Tools after polish. Cross-domain presentation uses unmanaged SignalBus lanes: MechHapticSignalDTO, SiltExplosionSignal, AcousticEchoTap, and core HapticRequest.
SELF_AUDIT.DEAR_LIE_CONFIRMATION: The mech is a mathematical sphere sampled against an analytic SDF cave, not a limb collider rig. Wall grab is exact SDF clearance plus zero velocity, not a Unity joint. Purge is scalar mass reduction plus vertical impulse, not buoyancy or ballast fluid. Before the Dear Lie, limb/feet collision would be O(limbs * contact queries + joint solver iterations); after it, low tier is O(1) SDF sample and ultra is O(8) bounded SDF samples.
